# Disclosures {#sec-app-disclosures}

{{< include _generated/appendix/disclosures.md >}}

## After the freeze

The facts below were recorded after the tag {{< var prereg.tag.v1.name >}}. Each is stated in the decisions log, reproduced verbatim in [Appendix @sec-app-deviations], and is collected here so that a reader need not search for it.

1. **The cloud pilot looked at timing only.** A pilot of {{< var cost.pilot_minutes >}} minutes on the rented GPU, after the freeze and before any confirmatory run, measured steps per second and evaluation time. The log records that no diagnostic was looked at. The pilot re-ran the gate, whose learning check reproduces a pre-freeze number exactly, so it exposed nothing new.
2. **The budget deviation preceded every confirmatory run.** {{< var prereg.tag.v11.name >}} was tagged at {{< var prereg.tag.v11.time >}} UTC on the day of the freeze; the first confirmatory run ({{< var ledger.first_cell >}}) started at {{< var ledger.first_start_time >}} and finished at {{< var ledger.first_end_time >}}. The deviation was decided from the pilot's timing.
3. **Three deviations followed the start of confirmatory runs.** The first primary cells had metrics files by {{< var timing.primary_metrics >}} UTC. The analysis code was first committed at {{< var timing.analysis_commit >}} UTC that night; {{< var prereg.tag.v12.name >}} (the incomplete-seed rule) was tagged at {{< var prereg.tag.v12.time >}}, {{< var prereg.tag.v13.name >}} (the survey-comparison rules) at {{< var prereg.tag.v13.time >}} and {{< var prereg.tag.v14.name >}} (the survey section of the report) at {{< var prereg.tag.v14.time >}}. They were fixed after confirmatory runs had started and their metrics files existed, but before the analysis code had been run on any real metrics and before any trained model was run on survey data.
4. **Per-run diagnostics were printed to logs.** The evaluation step prints a run's prior-set excess error, gap and κ to its log, so per-run diagnostics existed in readable form while those deviations were being fixed. No verdict and no summary of H1 to H3 had been computed.
5. **The analysis rule for incomplete seed groups never applied.** All {{< var runs.complete >}} planned runs finished and no group was incomplete.
6. **Resumed runs.** {{< var runs.n_resumed >}} runs were resumed from a checkpoint after an interruption (an instance deletion, the laptop sleeping or being unplugged). One attempt of one laptop run stopped on an internal error of the GPU backend and was resumed. All {{< var ledger.n_rows >}} ledger rows have return code 0.
7. **Lost checkpoints.** The checkpoints of {{< var runs.n_lost_ckpt >}} primary runs, and the two earlier checkpoints of one more, were lost with a cloud instance. Their evaluation files had been copied and are complete, so every verdict can be recomputed; those models cannot be re-evaluated.
8. **TF32 on the cloud cells.** Cloud training and evaluation used TF32 matrix multiplication. Re-evaluating two cloud cells in full precision moved excess error by up to {{< var tf32.max_mse_shift >}} points and the gap by up to {{< var tf32.max_gap_shift >}}.
9. **Spend.** The cloud work cost about \${{< var cost.total_usd >}} over the {{< var cost.n_instances >}} sweep instances, about {{< var cost.hours >}} instance-hours, plus the pilot instance (about \${{< var cost.pilot_usd >}}) if it was billed separately, so \${{< var cost.total_usd >}} to about \${{< var cost.total_with_pilot_usd >}} in total, not yet reconciled against the provider's bill. That is over the \${{< var cost.sweep_cap_usd >}} set aside for the sweep and at or just over the \${{< var cost.cloud_cap_usd >}} cloud cap of the pre-registration, depending on the pilot; the owner's overall limit of \${{< var cost.hard_limit_usd >}} held. A stalled file copy lost about {{< var cost.lost_hours >}} GPU-hours of work. No cell was added, dropped or re-run selectively because of the overrun.
10. **Nothing was flagged.** No size-l verdict was "different" and no H3 combination was positive after adjustment, so the re-training at {{< var design.steps_long >}} steps was not needed and was not run.
11. **No deviation followed the reading of H1 to H3.** The entries of the log dated after the results were read record the spend, the choice of venue, the timing above and the publication of the repository.
12. **Self-registration.** The repository was made public at {{< var meta.public_time >}} UTC on {{< var meta.public_date >}}, with the tags {{< var prereg.first_tag >}} to {{< var prereg.last_tag >}} pushed unchanged. The tags existed only locally until then.
13. **The author's confirmation of the sign-off postdates the results.** The statement in the author's own words quoted in [Appendix @sec-app-prereg] was given on {{< var signature.date >}}, after H1 to H3 had been read. It confirms the sign-off recorded on {{< var prereg.signoff_date >}}; it was not made at the freeze.
14. **An earlier report.** A report-series edition of this study, written from the same results files, preceded this paper. The paper's numbers are generated independently from `results/summary.csv` and `results/hypotheses.json`.
